text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior A
text_block_list.text: Ready, aaand!

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Juniors
text_block_list.text: Sirius-saaan! Do your best!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Japan Cup. With Katsuragi 
Ace and Mr. C.B. joining the fray, Tokyo 
Racecourse was enveloped in feverish 
excitement.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile— something else was drawing 
immense attention.

text_block_list.name: Ramonu's Fan
text_block_list.text: U-Um...! You're Mejiro Ramonu-san, right!?

text_block_list.name: Ramonu's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on achieving the Triple 
Tiara! I was trembling so much in the 
stands—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And as he grew excited, Mejiro Ramonu 
silenced his lips with her index finger.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Boy, do you know what day it is today?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Dwelling on past love is taboo. Shouldn't 
your eyes be on the turf right in front of 
you?

text_block_list.name: Ramonu's Fan
text_block_list.text: Ah, I-I'm so sorry! Thank you very much!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...It's the first Triple Tiara in history. 
Anyone would be over the moon seeing you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: However, that is in the past now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—You came here because you sensed a future 
too, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: That something was about to begin.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...It's not for such an exaggerated 
reason.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I simply wanted to watch my former sworn 
allies clash, as their friend.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That's all it is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
............ My, aren't your manners as 
impeccably polite as ever?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A swirl of excitement fills the spectator 
stands everywhere. Meanwhile, in the 
underground tunnel—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"My condition ain't bad. I can see the 
path to victory. And above all—"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"The crowd is radiating plenty of energy. 
Everyone's eyes are glued to this."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Thanks to a certain few folks, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
After getting riled up like that, I sure 
as hell can't show 'em a disappointing 
run...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
—I'm looking forward to it, Sirius. That 
burning passion of yours.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—...The stage is set. All that's left is 
to snatch it away from the side.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Huh? Like I'd know.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Every damn Umamusume is like that. I just 
don't bother wearing a mask."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
If I win the Japan Cup, nobody'll be able 
to complain. The skies of Paris are 
practically in reach.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You'd better start warming up your engine 
soon, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All to become a shining star! The highly 
anticipated Japan Cup, gathering the 
strongest, has begun!
